name: Consent
description: Records a patient's consent for various policies or data usage.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning patient — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may access this consent record.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: The patient who granted or denied consent.

attributes.name: policyName
attributes.description: The name of the policy or data usage for which consent is recorded.

attributes.name: consentDate
attributes.description: The date and time when consent was granted or updated.

attributes.name: isGranted
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent was granted (true) or denied (false).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version of the policy document to which consent applies.

attributes.name: documentLink
attributes.description: A URL link to the full policy document.

attributes.name: details
attributes.description: Additional details or notes regarding the consent.
